description: This is a Python test module for the litellm library, specifically testing the Bedrock GPT-OSS OpenAI models integration. It contains test cases for different aspects of the GPT-OSS models such as model parameter handling, prompt caching, and cost estimation, utilizing pytest and unittest.mock for testing.

classes.name: TestBedrockGPTOSS
classes.description: A test class for the Bedrock GPT-OSS models in the litellm library, inheriting from BaseLLMChatTest to test various model-related functionalities.

methods.name: dict get_base_completion_call_args(self)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with default arguments for model completion calls, specifically setting the model to 'bedrock/converse/openai.gpt-oss-20b-1:0'.

methods.name: test_tool_call_no_arguments(self, tool_call_no_arguments)
methods.description: Tests the translation of tool calls with no arguments, referencing a specific issue in the repositories.

methods.name: test_prompt_caching(self)
methods.description: Checks prompt caching behavior, noting that override is temporarily in place until Bedrock prompt caching is supported.

methods.name: test_completion_cost(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the cost reporting of the Bedrock GPT-OSS models, particularly their handling of token counts.

methods.name: test_reasoning_effort_transformation_gpt_oss(self, model)
methods.description: Validates that the 'reasoning_effort' parameter is correctly handled for GPT-OSS models, ensuring it appears in the parameters sent to the model and is not replaced by 'thinking'.
